schema2.description: Slice-1 overview contract. PublisherId identifies a boot; sequence increases within it. Deploy schema-1+2 readers before publishing 2. Retain unknown raw codes. Product owns aggregation, freshness assessment, ordering, action classification, payload bounds and relay enforcement. Future sections may be added without changing this major.

healthInstant.description: Calendar-valid UTC ISO instant; source evidence time, never publisher refresh time.

healthFreshness.description: Source observation time is independent of publisher heartbeat. Preserve last good timestamps on failure; null is unknown, never observed zero.

healthRemediation.description: Last persisted remediation attempt and result; no refresh action is implied.

healthEscalation.description: Only explicit humanOnly true may project to Needs you. actionRef links the existing action for deduplication.

healthEpisode.description: Stable episode identity; unknown severity codes stay visible in rawSeverity. Missing remediation is unknown, not success.

healthPause.description: Explicit intentional pause evidence, distinct from stalled work.

healthDaemon.description: Completion and heartbeat are separate evidence. Assess stalls only against evidenced cadence; null cadence is never inferred.

healthBudgetCoverage.description: Request attribution coverage; null is unmeasured, not zero. Preserve torn/truncated source coverage in reason.

healthBudgetWindow.description: Keep identity/resource/reset windows separate. Counts are response headroom observations, not live balances; an expired reset stays stale until a new response. Never infer identity from caller labels.

healthOvernight.description: Read-only evidence, not a control API. Preserve raw mode/state codes. Null job scope/next check must not be invented. Requested stop with running jobs remains pending or conflicting; policy alone cannot prove stopped.

healthEpisodes.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

healthDaemons.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

healthBudgetWindows.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

health.description: Optional schema-2 health evidence. Omission in older snapshots means unavailable. Each source retains its own observation/success times, cadence, completeness and reason. All supplied fields are validated; unknown values are explicit nulls with explanatory status/reason. Temporal comparisons, reference joins and arithmetic remain consumer responsibilities.
